verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a business communications SaaS that holds messages, calls and transcripts, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a user-selectable data region or residency option. Canadian virtual numbers are a phone-number feature, and the us-west-2 S3 bucket only hosts the OpenAPI spec files; neither is customer data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
